describes: results/results_long.parquet (authoritative merged copy of the Stage 09 formal run)
unit_of_record: CP result cell = dataset x seed x model x cp_method x m_minority (m_majority=200, alpha=0.1 fixed)

columns.description: Conformal target miscoverage; fixed 0.1 (nominal coverage 90%).
Immutable Stage 09 cell artifact identifier (run-scoped).
Test-set average precision of the base predictive pipeline (invariant across CP/m).
Test-set AUROC of the base predictive pipeline (invariant across CP/m).
Mean binary prediction-set size = singleton_rate + 2*doubleton_rate.
SHA-256 of the producing code snapshot (model-family-specific).
SHA-256 of the producing configuration lock (model-family-specific).
|coverage_minority - coverage_majority| on the test split.
Majority-class test coverage = covered_count_majority / n_test_majority.
Upper endpoint of the two-sided 95% Wilson interval (z=1.959963984540054, no continuity correction, clipped to [0,1]).
Lower endpoint of the same Wilson interval.
Minority-class test coverage = covered_count_minority / n_test_minority.
Upper Wilson endpoint for minority coverage.
Lower Wilson endpoint for minority coverage.
Overall test coverage = covered_count_overall / n_test.
Upper Wilson endpoint for overall coverage.
Lower Wilson endpoint for overall coverage.
Test majority samples whose true label is included in the prediction set.
Test minority samples whose true label is included in the prediction set.
covered_count_minority + covered_count_majority.
